inline_prompts: You are given a positive integer N and a sequence of positive integers A = (A_1,A_2,\dots,A_N) of length N. Determine whether A is strictly increasing, that is, whether A_i < A_{i+1} holds for every integer i with 1 \leq i < N. Output format must match examples exactly, including capitalization. Input The input is given from Standard Input in the following format: N A_1 A_2 \dots A_N Output If A is strictly increasing, print Yes; otherwise, print No. The judge is case-insensitive. Constraints - 2 \leq N \leq 100 - 1 \leq A_i \leq 1000 \ (1 \leq i \leq N) - All input values are integers.
